scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them out, but never at night. Oren's persuasion gets the price down to two silver. Sela says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water. She will be at pier four at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party climbs to the mine, whose air is warm and smells of candle wax. Thirty paces in the tunnel is flooded with warm black water and floating hymn-book pages. Teo finds a page with the pencil margin note "M. Brand" and recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess that harbor-master Maren is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: The party goes to the shore at dusk despite Sela's warning. Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under water and the humming is much louder than two nights ago. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor, then vanish. The GM notes the choir clock is at three of six. The party flees.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide tomorrow, with Sela rowing them at first light. Dana will buy rope and a second lantern. Innkeeper Bram feeds them for free and says he has known Maren for thirty years: sharp tongue, good heart, she lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and is back to full.
